annotations.title: Wire transfer fees at one bank

description: One US bank's published wire fees: outgoing and incoming domestic wires, international wires sent in dollars or in foreign currency, incoming international wires, same-day cutoff times, fee waivers, what the bank says about its exchange rate, the fee schedule date and the source document link. Personal accounts cover 17 banks and credit unions; business accounts cover 9 banks.

account_type.description: personal (consumer checking) or business (business checking). Default personal.

bank.description: Bank name or common short name, e.g. "Chase", "Bank of America", "BofA", "Navy Federal", "Schwab".
